Explanation: Optimizer has found a markdown solution which satisfies the target STR requirement and achieves the highest STR it can. Optimization is successful. STR is achieved. Alias: OPTIMIZER_STR_ACHIEVED.
Optimal markdown solution does not satisfy the target STR requirement. Optimization is unsuccessful. STR could not be achieved. Alias: OPTIMIZER_STR_NOT_ACHIEVED.
Optimal markdown solution does not satisfy the target STR requirement due to the remaining store inventory.
Optimal markdown solution does not satisfy the target STR requirement due to the remaining upstream inventory.
Optimization is not feasible because markdown price does not meet min and max price bounds (rounding logic applied). A default discount is applies in this case. Optimization is unsuccessful.
Optimizer exceeded the budget of a paritition. Min feasible discount is applied in this case to all the items in the partition.

Optimization is not feasible becasue of corrupted item data. There could be one or more of the following corruptions: missing elasticity, zero or missing average daily sales data, zero or missing projected start gate inventory. Min feasible discount is applied in this case. Alias: CORRUPTED_MIN_MARKDOWN.
Optimizer is not run. Group original price falls into the low price criteria. Low price rule is applied instead. Alias: LOW_PRICE.
Optimization not needed. Target STR achieved without any markdown.
